format: Readable export of visible user/assistant messages from the original chat and prior transferred branch. Not a native Codex session import.
limitations: Snapshot ends at export time; later replies in the current export task are not included.
Messages from the previous transferred branch are preserved and ordered by timestamp; decisions in RESUME.md take precedence over historical proposals.
Only available user image payloads are included. Referenced source documents are indexed separately in sources/manifest.json.
Account settings, connections, installed dependencies and live browser state do not transfer.
